title: Chapter 767 The Power Of Destruction; Harvest!
content:
Chapter 767 The Power Of Destruction; Harvest!

Chapter 767 The Power of Destruction; Harvest!

Water God Palace.

Ma Zheng sat cross-legged and tried his best to enter a state of cultivation.

However, his expression was extremely flustered and he was unable to meditate.

Too many things had happened during this period of time, filling his heart with fear and unease.

"Ma Zheng!"

At this moment, a deep voice sounded in his mind.

Ma Zheng was stunned.

Then, his face revealed an unconcealable excitement.

He hurriedly knelt on the ground respectfully and said,"Master!"

When people were in danger, they usually liked to look for someone to rely on.

And Lin Fan was undoubtedly Ma Zheng's greatest support.

Lin Fan asked," Do you know anything about the World-Destroying Golden Lotus?"

When Ma Zheng heard this, his face turned slightly pale.

He had heard of it before!

In fact, it was because he had heard of the World-Destroying Golden Lotus that he had been so flustered recently.

It was a terrifying magical treasure that could destroy the world, destroy all the universes, and make all living beings disappear.

During this period of time, Ma Zheng felt like a prisoner waiting for the death penalty. He was in extreme despair.

"I know about the World-Destroying Golden Lotus. It is currently in the 29th Heaven and is constantly descending. However, I don't know when it will destroy the entire world."Ma Zheng said in a trembling voice.

"Alright, I understand." Lin Fan said."

After saying that, he directly ended the soul communication.

Then, Lin Fan scanned Hu Tian, Qiu Ziqian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue and the rest with his consciousness and took a step forward.

"Whoosh!"

In the next moment, he appeared in the 29th Heaven.

This was a vast starry sky.

There were many people standing in the sky.

Their bodies were filled with a tyrannical aura. They looked up at the starry sky with extremely solemn expressions and occasionally let out a discussion.

"What exactly is that golden lotus?"

"The aura is too terrifying."

"It contains endless energy."

"He's here!"

....

"Whoosh!"

In an instant, the entire world turned golden. Everyone was blinded at this moment.

There was only a golden lotus floating in the air.

This... It was the World-Destroying Golden Lotus.

"Rumble!"

Wherever the golden lotus passed, space shattered and planets exploded. Everything turned into nothingness. It was extremely terrifying.

An extreme fear surged into everyone's hearts like a tidal wave.

At this moment, a tall and handsome figure stepped under the golden lotus.

He... It was Lin Fan.

He saw…

Lin Fan raised his hand slowly.

"Whoosh!"

The golden lotus, which was originally powerful enough to destroy the entire world, suddenly shrank.

In the end, it turned into a golden light and entered Lin Fan's body.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan took another step forward and disappeared from the spot.

And the crisis of the apocalypse was over.

The world returned to normal.

The people floating in the air gasped for breath.

When they saw the golden lotus disappear, they looked at each other, not knowing what had happened.

....

Above the 49th Heaven.

Subhuti, who had been sitting quietly in the lotus position, suddenly opened his eyes.

His hands kept fiddling with it, and his eyes were wide open as he cried out in horror,"The World-Destroying Golden Lotus actually cut off all contact with me and completely disappeared!"

"How is this possible!"

"Whoosh!"

Subhuti suddenly rose to his feet.

He had not left the 49th Layer of Heaven for tens of thousands of years, but now, it was rare for him to leave.

In just a moment, he had arrived at the 29th Heaven.

Subhuti stared at the void that had been destroyed by the World-Destroying Golden Lotus. The World-Destroying Golden Lotus was nowhere to be seen, and his face was extremely ugly to behold.

....

The news of the disappearance of the World-Destroying Golden Lotus swept across the world like a storm.

Countless people rejoiced, and some even cried tears of joy.

This was normal. After all, he had survived a calamity.

Water God Palace.

When Ma Zheng learned that the World Annihilating Golden Lotus had disappeared, he was stunned.

Happiness, shock, and other emotions instantly filled his entire body.

He was happy because he did not have to die.

Was it because he had told Lin Fan about the Golden Lotus of Annihilation? Was the crisis of the Golden Lotus of Annihilation resolved?

Could it be…Was this Lin Fan's doing?

The more he thought about it, the more shocked Ma Zheng became.

At the same time, Lin Fan became even more majestic and majestic in his heart.

....

At this moment, Lin Fan had already returned to Earth.

As soon as he sat down, a crisp notification sounded in his mind.

[Ding! Bodhi's hatred towards you has increased to 6 stars.]

Lin Fan raised his brows.

6 stars!

Good heavens, was he going to fight to the death with him?

Although he was a legendary figure, his path had been narrowed!

[Ding! Ma Zheng's favorability towards you has increased to 10 stars.]

10 stars of favorability?

Lin Fan's face revealed a strange look.

Up until now, only his Dao partners and relatives had such a high affinity for him.

Now, Ma Zheng was also 10 stars?

Perhaps he should be rewarded?

At the thought of this, Lin Fan used his soul connection with Ma Zheng once more.

"Master!" When Ma Zheng heard Lin Fan's voice, he quickly crawled on the ground.

Lin Fan said," You've been cultivating water attribute skills, right?""

"Yes, Master." Ma Zheng said.

In the past, he had a certain talent for the water attribute.

However, it wasn't his main cultivation.

After that, he joined the Raincloud Altar and the Water God Palace.

Gradually, it changed to his main cultivation.

Lin Fan said," Alright, I'll teach you a skill.""

Hence, Lin Fan passed on a Holy Lord level skill that he had obtained from the system to Ma Zheng.

Ma Zheng had spent a long time before he finally grasped a little of it.

However, even so, it still allowed his cultivation to increase by a large margin.

In addition, Ma Zheng had a very real feeling that as long as he continued to cultivate according to the cultivation technique, his future would definitely be limitless!

He had easily given him such a cultivation technique.

The more Ma Zheng thought about it, the more he felt that Lin Fan was the one who had dealt with the World-Destroying Golden Lotus.

Therefore, Ma Zheng kowtowed to the ground again and said excitedly,"Thank you, Master, for your divine technique!"

Lin Fan nodded in satisfaction," Cultivate well.""

After saying that, he ended the soul communication.

Following that, Lin Fan placed his attention on a golden lotus flower floating within his body.

"Tsk!"

At this moment, the golden lotus flower quickly melted and turned into streaks of golden light in his body.

These golden lights quickly gathered and turned into a dazzling golden pearl.

It was at this moment that Lin Fan heard another notification in his mind.

[Ding! You have completed the mission. Absorb the World Destroying Golden Lotus and obtain the power of destruction. You have obtained 10 Saint King Crystals and 5 Great Dao fragments.]

[Power of Destruction: Possesses the special power to destroy the world once.]

When Lin Fan heard this, his heart skipped a beat.

Destroy the world…Such power was simply terrifying.

Then, he looked at the Saint King Crystal that contained endless pure energy and the Great Dao fragment that was filled with a special aura, and a faint smile appeared on his face.

The harvest this time was not bad.
